What GXO Logistics says to expect

  • Full year 2026: growth, EBITDA, EPS, cash flowThe Company reaffirmed its guidance for the full year 2026 as follows: • Organic revenue growth 1 of 4% to 5%; • Adjusted EBITDA 1 of $945 million to $965 million; • Adjusted diluted EPS 1 of $2.95 to $3.15; and • Free cash flow conversion 1 of 30% to 40%.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed November 3, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
